regions.scope: The weighted Taylor majorant gives injectivity on the stated standard coordinate cube. Exact nonnegative supersolutions give componentwise inverse stability. Within the complete inherited two-field class, root errors at most r<L and both observations in this cube imply feature separation at least 2(L-r)/h[1]; independent feature errors strictly below (L-r)/h[1] cannot erase field identity. No global result outside this cube or optimal noise threshold is claimed.
